title: Visual-to-DOM Reverse Engineering
description: Begin with what a human sees on screen (visual screenshots or live UI), trace every visual component down to its exact code/DOM/schema representation, and synthesize into robust automation logic.
ai_training_notes: When the user shares images or UI layouts, correlate visual regions with DOM nodes, class names, and attributes. Never copy-paste dummy sample text; extract the dynamic container schema.
satisfaction_driver: User expects the AI to deeply study screenshots, extract subtle details (like SVG icons, ratings, expanders), and reverse engineer why the platform works that way.
